title: Can LLMs Deceive CLIP? Benchmarking Adversarial Compositionality of Pre-trained Multimodal Representation via Text Updates
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical benchmarking of compositional vulnerabilities and adversarial robustness in multimodal models like CLIP. While it contains a standard ethics statement regarding the use of LLMs and annotator compensation, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
